case.scope: 观察嵌套子 Agent 的实际父子关系。

prompts: Use spawn_agent to create one child. Tell that child to use spawn_agent to create exactly one grandchild which replies SYNTHETIC_GRANDCHILD. Have the child wait for its grandchild then report its output. Wait for your child. Use no tools except spawn_agent and wait, and do not read or write files or use network.
